name: CostClaw
tagline: Find the leak in your Claude Code spend
voice: An honest receipt under warm shop light: terracotta ink on clean white paper, precise and unfussy. Terse, technical, dry; leads with real numbers; all data and commands render in mono. Clay #e07a5f is a graphic color only (bars, the mark, rules, washes) and NEVER carries text; colored text uses umber. Background is white paper, never dark-terminal, never fintech navy. Green appears only as the score-strong accent. Waste and emphasis read as deep clay and umber, not red. No glow, no hype, no em dashes.
